term: finite interpretation of the naturalist fragments
definition: Extends the existing Metaethics.Sig with welfare, objective-interest satisfaction, impartial rightness, positive cluster contributions and instrumental reasons. Two Bool agents receive equal benefit units; Bool actions distinguish positive and negative cases; Bool sentences assert opposite actions. A two-person equal-benefit maximizing criterion is realized by the positive act. This stipulative interpretation proves encoded satisfiability and non-entailment of categorical instrumental reasons, not empirical truth, an actual natural grounding or equivalence of whole theories.
note: A deliberately small finite countermodel for issue #249. Real psychology, aggregation and homeostasis would require empirical source premises; this fixture supplies none of them.
